category: uptime and browser check monitoring with status pages

free_tier.stated: Hobby plan, free: 3 uptime monitors at a 3-minute check interval, 1,000 browser check runs a month, up to 2 users, 1 limited status page with 100 email subscribers, 14 days of data retention, email, Slack, Discord and Telegram alerts and authenticated API and MCP access; no SMS alerts and no webhooks
free_tier.notes: The allowance mixes a count of monitors with a monthly count of browser check runs, so no single unit of the vocabulary fits. The Pro plan starts at USD 25 a month with 35 monitors, 3,000 browser check runs and a 30-second check interval; its button and the Hobby button both read Start trial, and whether Hobby has an end date is unverified: not stated on the pricing page.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a monitor checks a target; nothing is stored per object

retention.stated: 14 days of data retention on Hobby, against 12 months on Pro

egress.terms: not applicable: an outbound checker; monitor data is read back through the authenticated API, which the pricing page lists as available on every plan

interface_detail: The pricing page lists authenticated API and MCP access as available on Hobby, Pro and Enterprise; the API reference page was not found at the address tried, so its host, authentication scheme and limits are unverified.
tooling: the web app, the authenticated API and an MCP server
chaining: External uptime and browser checks on up to 3 endpoints of free-hosted services every 3 minutes, with Slack, Discord or Telegram alerts and a status page.

limits.value: 3 uptime monitors and 1,000 browser check runs per month on Hobby
14 days of data retention on Hobby

limits_note: Hobby has up to 2 users, no SMS alerts and no webhooks.
binding_note: The 3-monitor cap is reached first by any app with more than a few endpoints.

identity_cost.detail: unverified: the get-started page text shows only a Create your monitoring workspace heading and an agreement to the terms, and the pricing page states no credit card term for Hobby.

reliability_note: no throttle, ban or data loss is stated on the pages read beyond the 14-day data retention
confidence_note: Plan limits are quoted from the first-party pricing page. No account was opened, so the sign-up fields, the card term and the API host are unverified: behind a sign-up.
